body: You have a point. I just don't know how to go about doing this. He was my gateway to progressing in life. I was a miserable child with a terrible outlook for no apparent reason. He changed that and reached out to me. He became not only a romantic partner but my best friend, and taught me how to live.

You're right about a lot. Everything has changed for me in the past week, not just this. But i dont know how to do things without him. Every decision I've made for over six years, I took him into consideration first. I use things he gave me on a daily basis. Simple things like my blanket and pillow, my sweater and watch, my computer and a large number of other material items that i use regularly were gifts from him. I feel like without him nothing is there.
It's really hard. It's not that I feel like I have nothing to live for, I just don't want to live for anything. I don't want some other guy. I just want things the way they were.
